title: security: rbac v2 - fix audit logging when KMS region-residency enforcement triggers
author: Lina Hoffman
description: Context: RBAC v2 introduced region-residency checks that enforce KMS region pinning for workspace keys. In the previous rollout we observed intermittent missing audit entries when enforcement rejected a request during the authorization step. This PR fixes the audit pipeline so that every enforcement decision (allow/deny/fallback) for KMS region residency is recorded consistently in the audit log and surfaces the KMS key region metadata.
commits: a1b2c3d: rbac: surface kms_region on enforcement decision objects
d4e5f6g: audit: ensure audit logger invoked before early returns in enforcement flow
h7i8j9k: tests: add unit+integration tests for kms region-residency audit cases
l0m1n2o: docs: add release note and migration guidance for audit retention

approvals: Mason Lee - approved (requested minor test rename)
review_comments: Priya Nair: Great catch - I saw missing audit rows in the incident runbook. Can you confirm this covers both cached and immediate enforcement paths?
Author (Lina Hoffman): Yes - added a guard in cached-path and an integration test that exercises both code paths.
Mason Lee: Small nit: prefer explicit enum mapping for kms_region to avoid empty-string cases; test added.
CI Bot: build passed on linux, flaky test 'kms_residency_integration_test' rerun and passed
release_notes: Fix: Ensure audit logs consistently record KMS region-residency enforcement decisions. No API changes. Backport to release/2025.11 recommended for customers with strict audit requirements.
notes_on_testing: Added unit tests for enforcement surface and kms_region mapping
Added integration test that runs a simulated request where KMS region pinning triggers deny and verifies audit entry
Manual QA: exercised workspace key rotation + cross-region deny in staging cluster and validated audit rows in CloudWatch/ELK
motivation_summary: Missing audit events hindered post-incident forensics and compliance reporting. This change guarantees audit visibility for any region-residency enforcement decision and includes region metadata for downstream processors.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: adding audit call in hot path could add latency. Mitigation: audit logger is async and uses bounded batching; measured 0.5ms P50 increase in staging.
Risk: telemetry volume increase. Mitigation: added sampling and optional filtering by workspace tier (configurable via helm values).
author_acknowledgements: Thanks to Priya for the incident triage and tests
Special thanks to the observability team for helping validate audit ingestion
